details.detail: Overall massing and layout: the 1.30 m shell, 2.20 m length, aisle-side wardrobe, window console, angled pier, lowered centre divider, and the centre seat narrowed to 0.63 so it no longer overlaps the armrest. All still match omaat_f7, f3, f5 and f49.

Forward aisle-corner hood: fixed and verified. One rounded taupe prow about 0.13 wide cantilevers about 0.11 inboard over the pier, which reads like omaat_f4 (both aisles) and f3 (2G). It is still a separate block sitting on the aisle cap with a visible step (s6/w_aisle: a 'sausage' on the cap). In f4 the hood is the continuation of the cap and runs down into the wall's side face.

Headrest flap: fixed. It now hangs from the top edge with a wrap-over, measures 0.56 x 0.20 (f9: 0.55 x 0.19 by the 0.72 back) and is 1.25x the back (f9 1.17x). In studio light it renders slightly blue (#5a5f65 against a back of #48423c), where f9 is neutral (#93948e). It still reads a little like a glass pane.

Reading spots: fixed, now off, with a chrome ring and dark lens. They are too small and too far inboard. Model: 0.048 diameter at ±0.33. f9: about 0.075 diameter (50 px on a 475 px = 0.72 m back), set just OUTSIDE the back edges at the header corners (x 370 / 920, a spacing of about 0.83 m), as protruding eyeballs.

Seat niche and back: the jambs now follow SW, and the seams and back are right. The header renders the same tone as the back (#494744 against #48423c). In f9 the header is 1.17x lighter than the back (#938571 against #7e776f), so the niche outline is lost in seat_front and c_front.

Lilac pillow (seat mode): no longer a slab, but the 5-section loft's width taper (0.36 to 0.45 to 0.36) makes an OCTAGON or hexagonal gem outline in seat_front, s4 and c_front. f9 and f5 show a rectangular 0.52 x 0.33 pillow with pinched 'ear' corners and a diamond jacquard. The colour is right.
Window console: the taupe fascia over a near-black body, the warm fTray wood (fixed), the keypad and the handset still match f7, f13 and f49.

Window-suite screen wall: the mirror is fixed (a light blue-grey pill in a cap rim now reads as a mirror, as in f10). The proportions are still off. The wing is 0.088 visible with an r 0.05 corner that is invisible at that width. f10 and f49 show the window wing at about 0.15 m of dark wood with a large-radius upper outer corner edged in taupe. Widening the wing shrank the aisle pier to pw 0.126 m, while f10 shows the pier at about 0.28 m projected (180 px against the 605 px screen) with the mirror centred in wood and the lamp outboard of it. The model's pier is now a sliver.

Centre-pair fins: added but mirrored WRONG. Each fin sits at x = -hx+0.03 and is rotated ry = -18 deg. M4.trs maps local z +0.28 to x -0.087, so the aft end swings 0.057 past the divider into the neighbour's suite and the two fins CROSS in an X (the q02 crop shows the two taupe fin caps crossing). f5, taken from the screen end, shows the two fins diverging AFT, a V whose apex is at the divider at the screen wall. f3 shows the 2D fin starting beside the 2G screen edge and leaning into 2D, where it hides 2D's screen edge. The fins also render near-black (#1f1917) against f3's #3e342b.

Aisle door leaves: fixed geometry. 0.055 stiles (f49 frame ~13 % of the leaf) and a 0.019 pitch with about 23 rounded ribs per leaf (my groove count: ~22 per leaf in both f49 and pb_20) are now right. Aliasing remains. q02 (x 700-930) still shows a woven cross-hatch at grazing angles, and w_aisle head-on shows wavy moire across the forward leaf.
Ottoman and void: unchanged and still right (f10 cantilevered bench over a dark void).

Bed mode: the pillows are now propped against the niche, white behind and lilac in front (f46, fixed). The duvet (#e2dfd8) on the pad (#f0efea) has no visible edge, fold or shadow in q04, so the bed reads as one bare white slab. f46 shows the duvet folded lengthwise to the window half, exposing the sheet, with sateen stripes, and a padded headboard panel with a horizontal seam behind the pillows.

Seat plaque: it is now a flush slot, but it still renders as a dark (#5a5550-ish) inset tile inside a lighter border with white text (q02 crop). The white text is known and waits on the integrator. The slot interior is still much darker than the cap, where f9, f49 and f7 show a cap-tone pill that is only slightly darker. The position (-0.80, near the forward end of the parked aft leaf) checks out against f7 and f49.

issues.problem: The centre-screen fins cross in an X when they should form a V that opens aft
issues.detail: 09d_suite.js centre branch: fin = M4.trs(-hx + 0.03, 0, -L + 0.15, -18*DEG). ry = -18 deg sends the aft end of the fin (local z +0.28) to x -0.087, which is past the divider at x = -hx. The mirrored neighbour does the same, so the two fins and their fCap tops intersect.
issues.evidence: q02_suiteAisle.png crop x 380-560, y 70-320: two dark boards with crossing taupe caps. Checked numerically: M4.trs(0,0,0,-18deg) gives r02 = -0.309. omaat_f5: the two fins seen from the screen end diverge going aft. omaat_f3: the 2D fin starts next to the 2G screen edge and leans into 2D, hiding 2D's screen edge.
issues.fix: Use fin = M4.trs(-hx + 0.006, 0, -L + 0.15, +18*DEG), so the forward ends meet at the divider line and each aft end leans 0.087 into its own suite. Keep the local z +0.14 centre. Check that the fin clears the screen bezel at z -L+0.14; if not, start the fin at -L+0.155. Also give the fin its own slightly lighter wood (about '#4a3d34', fWood layer) or rely on the lighting pass, since it renders #1f1917 against f3's #3e342b.

issues.problem: The window-suite screen wall is out of proportion: the wing is too narrow and the aisle pier is a sliver
issues.detail: wing 0.10 gives scx = -0.002 and pX0 = 0.486, so pw = (0.575 - 0.486)/cos45 = 0.126 m and mW is 0.076 in a 0.126 pier. The wing shows 0.088 of wood with an r 0.05 corner that cannot be seen.
issues.evidence: omaat_f10 at the screen plane (605 px = 0.952 m): window wing ~95 px, about 0.15 m, with a big rounded upper outer corner in a taupe edge. The pier projects ~180 px, about 0.28 m, with the mirror (~0.087 x 0.46) centred in wood and the lamp outboard at the top. omaat_f49 top-left: the same wide wood wing with a round top corner. The inner width these imply is about 1.25 m, against the model's 1.165.
issues.fix: If the 1.24 m suite width is fixed by the layout, make the pier more oblique rather than narrower: pAng 60 deg with wing 0.08 gives pw = (0.575 - 0.466)/0.5 = 0.22. Draw the wing as a curved wood panel (0.12 wide at the console, sweeping to 0.06 at the cap with r ~0.10 on the upper outer corner) plus a 0.012 fCap edge band. Otherwise, ask the integrator whether the window suites can take +0.04 m from the aisle.

issues.problem: The fluted door leaves still alias into moire
issues.detail: About 23 separate 0.011 m ribs per leaf are thinner than a pixel beyond about 1.5 m. Lifting fFluteGap to #433c34 did not remove the pattern.
issues.evidence: q02 x 700-930 (the 2G/2K aisle leaves): a woven cross-hatch at grazing angle. studio/w_aisle.png forward leaf: wavy interference bands. Real f49 and pb_20: clean straight grooves.
issues.fix: In the cabin (non-studio) build, replace the rib loop with one quad per leaf carrying a mipmapped groove texture (an atlas 'flute' rect of 23 periods, 45 % dark), or use a far-LOD with flat leaves plus 6-8 broad painted grooves beyond about 3 m. Keep the geometric ribs for the studio and close seat views only.

issues.problem: The lilac pillow outline is an octagon or hexagon, not a pillow
issues.detail: The seat-mode loft uses SEC widths 0.36/0.43/0.45/0.43/0.36 over 0.30 depth, so the four corners chamfer at 45 deg.
issues.evidence: studio/seat_front.png, s4_suiteW_seat.png and c_front.png: gem-like hexagons. omaat_f9 and f5: a rectangular ~0.52 x 0.33 pillow, plump in the middle, with pinched thin corners and a diamond jacquard.
issues.fix: Keep the thickness taper but set the widths to 0.46, 0.47, 0.47, 0.47, 0.46 (rectangular outline) with corner radius 0.01 at the end sections. Widen to 0.50 x 0.32. Add a low-gain diamond detail layer (LAYER.yDiamond or similar) if the shared layers allow it.

issues.problem: The reading spots are too small and sit inside the back width
issues.evidence: omaat_f9: eyeballs about 0.075 in diameter, at x 370 / 920 on a back of x 410-885, i.e. just outside the back edges at the header/jamb corners (spacing ~0.83 m). f5 and f46 are the same.
issues.fix: Place them at seatX ± (SW/2 + 0.05). Scale: body r 0.036, protruding 0.03, ring r 0.03, lens r 0.02 (a dark hemisphere if gSphere is available).

issues.problem: The niche header renders no lighter than the seat back
issues.detail: The header and jambs use fShell #69655f facing forward in shade.
issues.evidence: seat_front: header #494744, back #48423c. omaat_f9: header #938571, 1.17x the back #7e776f. f46 and f5 show a clear lighter taupe frame round the back.
issues.fix: Give the niche header and jambs fCap (#8a8272) or a new fNiche about '#80796b'.

issues.problem: The bed duvet cannot be seen against the pad
issues.detail: Duvet #e2dfd8 on pad #f0efea with no drape or edge shadow.
issues.evidence: q04: one white slab with pillows. omaat_f46: the duvet is folded to the window half, showing the sheet and the belt, with sateen stripes and a clear folded edge.
issues.fix: Make the duvet SW*0.55 wide, offset to the window side, with a 0.02 thicker rounded folded edge along the aisle side. Use a slightly warmer '#d9d4ca' so it separates from the pad. Optionally add a padded headboard panel with one horizontal seam at y 0.9 on the aft-wall niche face.

issues.problem: The hood sits on the cap as a separate lump
issues.detail: gRBox(0.13, 0.085, 0.40) at H + 0.02 above cap(0.04, 0.50) produces a step and a rounded 'sausage' on top of the cap in side views.
issues.evidence: studio/s6_suiteW_aisle.png and w_aisle.png: a cylinder-like roll on the forward cap. omaat_f4: the hood's top is flush with the cap run, and its outer face drops into the wall's side face.
issues.fix: Drop the cap() under the hood's z range (split the cap so it stops at -L+0.43), and set the hood top at H + 0.0625 to match the cap.

issues.problem: The plaque slot is still a dark tile
issues.detail: The plate '#6f675c' is covered by the glyph quad, whose atlas background shows dark. The white text is known and waits on the integrator.
issues.evidence: q02 crop: a dark inner rectangle inside a light rim. omaat_f49 '2K' and f9: the slot is only slightly darker than the cap.
issues.fix: When the integrator touches 06_atlas.js, draw suite tags with a transparent or cap-tone background, or shrink the glyph quad to the text bounds.

questionsForUser: Is the 1.24 m window-suite width fixed? Real photos (f10, f49) suggest the screen wall holds a ~0.15 m wood wing plus a ~0.25 m angled mirror pier beside the 43-in screen, which needs about 1.25 m of inner width.
